subject: general
question: Which country became the world's first country to transition to four-and-a half day work week?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The UAE**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The United Arab Emirates has announced to change its existing five-day workweek to a four-and-a-half day starting January 1, 2022.
 
• It has become the world's first country to make the employee-friendly transition as part of its efforts to improve productivity and work-life balance.
 
• Monday to Thursday the work timings would be from 7.30 am to 3.30 pm, followed by a half-day on Friday.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Saturdays and Sundays are full-day holidays under the new rule.
 
• Further, employees would be offered flexible working hours and work-from-home options on Friday.
 
• The new system will first be implemented in all federal government entities; schools, colleges, and private institutions are expected to follow suit.
